subject: FinCo: zero-trust ramp — SAML metadata, SCIM mapping, IP egress & service-account cadence
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Ramos <danielle.ramos@finco.com>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@finco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Sep 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: FinCo: zero-trust ramp — SAML metadata, SCIM mapping, IP egress & service-account cadence

Hi Danielle / Alex —

Great to meet last week. As we move from discovery into implementation, I wanted to align on the minimal items our infra team needs to hit the first sandbox cutover and the production rollout. I've attached a short checklist (finco_onboarding_zero_trust_checklist.xlsx) that maps items to owners and a suggested cadence.

Top asks to unblock sequencing:
- SAML IdP metadata (entityID, SSO endpoint, x509 cert) in XML form — we can use your metadata URL or an attached export.
- SCIM provisioning scope: do you want full user provisioning + group sync, or users-only for phase 1? Also confirm which SCIM attributes you expect mapped (email vs userName vs externalId).
- IP allowlist / egress ranges for test vs prod (static egress IPs or NAT ranges).
- Service account policy: does FinCo require unique service accounts per application environment? Any naming conventions or org policy constraints to enforce?
- Any org-level policy controls (e.g., enforced MFA, restricted SAML assertion attributes) that would impact mapping.

Proposed immediate cadence: sandbox cutover next Tuesday (09/26) with a dry run for SAML + SCIM, then prod tentatively two weeks after. Ben will be the primary implementation contact; Priyom will handle SCIM attribute mappings. Marissa and I will coordinate CS communication and approvals.

Can you confirm the above and either attach the IdP metadata and IP ranges or point us to the secure link? If there are procurement/compliance tasks we should loop in now, cc them and we'll adjust the timeline.

Thanks —
Monica
Sr. Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: finco_onboarding_zero_trust_checklist.xlsx

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@finco.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Danielle Ramos <danielle.ramos@finco.com>
Cc: FinCo Security <security@finco.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Sep 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FinCo: zero-trust ramp — SAML metadata, SCIM mapping, IP egress & service-account cadence

Monica — thanks, this is helpful. Attaching our IdP metadata export (saml-idp-metadata-sample.xml) and the current egress ranges for our test and prod NATs. Quick answers:

- Phase 1: users-only SCIM provisioning (groups in phase 2).
- SCIM attributes: we use email as the canonical identifier; userName is present but not authoritative. externalId is set for federated accounts only.
- Egress: test 198.51.100.0/26, prod 198.51.101.0/26 (we've also got specific host exceptions; see attached csv in the doc repo).
- Service accounts: we prefer a single per-environment service account (redwood-svc-sandbox, redwood-svc-prod). We'll attach the service-account template shortly.

We have a security review on Thursday morning — I'll loop in security@finco.com for any policy clarifications. We'll try to get the final SAML export and the service-account JSON by EOD today.

— Alex
IT Ops, FinCo
alex.chen@finco.com

Attachment: saml-idp-metadata-sample.xml

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@finco.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Sep 2028 11:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FinCo: zero-trust ramp — SAML metadata, SCIM mapping, IP egress & service-account cadence

Alex / team — thanks for the quick reply and the ranges. A couple of technical clarifications from implementation:

1) SAML: our SP requires the NameID to be either email or a persistent NameID. If you set email as NameIDFormat we'll map directly; otherwise we need an assertion with persistent ID and then map externalId.
2) SCIM attributes: mapping email -> user.email is fine. For phase-1 users-only provisioning we typically exclude the user "active" flag changes until we have deprovisioning playbook agreed. Is FinCo OK with delayed deprovisioning (48 hours manual) for sandbox?
3) Service account keys: we recommend short-lived keys for sandbox and rotated keys for prod every 30 days. If FinCo's org policy enforces HSM-backed keys or a specific KMS scope, send the KMS ARN/policy.
4) IP egress: our hosted platform will call back from specific NAT ranges (we'll request prod allowlist 198.51.150.0/27 and sandbox 198.51.150.32/27). We can also support TLS client cert pinning if FinCo prefers mutual TLS for admin endpoints.

Proposed dry-run schedule (all times PT):
- 2028-09-26 09:00-11:00: SAML handshake and sign-in smoke tests (Ben + Alex)
- 2028-09-26 13:00-15:00: SCIM provisioning dry run (Priyom + Alex)
- 2028-09-27 10:00: CS walkthrough and acceptance criteria (Monica + Danielle + Marissa)

I'll prepare a short runbook and a service-account sample JSON (service-account-sample.json) and drop it into the Drive link before EOD. If HSM/KMS is required, we'll update the prod rotation cadence in the runbook.

Ben Carter
Implementation Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0123

Attachment: service-account-sample.json

From: Danielle Ramos <danielle.ramos@finco.com>

Date: Tue, 18 Sep 2028 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FinCo: zero-trust ramp — SAML metadata, SCIM mapping, IP egress & service-account cadence

Monica / Ben —

Confirmed. Sandbox dry-run window works for us; please put calendar invites on 09/26 for the two blocks. We'll provide the IdP metadata and the service-account naming convention by EOD (Alex is pulling certs). For deprovisioning: sandbox manual 48h is fine; prod must be automated (we'll share the SCIM deprovisioning policy doc).

Also: Security asked if Redwood supports assertion attribute encryption (we do not require it by default); if you can document what attributes you store and retention timeframe, that will help the Thursday review.

Thanks —
Danielle Ramos
Head of Cloud Security, FinCo
Danielle.Ramos@finco.com

Thanks all — calendar invites sent for the sandbox blocks and I uploaded a brief runbook draft to the Drive link (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1FinCo-Onboarding). Action items: 
- Alex: attach final IdP export + service-account naming template (ETA EOD).
- Ben / Priyom: upload runbook and SCIM attribute mapping doc (Ben will draft, Priyom will review).
- Danielle / Security: share SCIM deprovisioning policy and any KMS/HSM constraints before Thursday review.
- Marissa: I'll prepare the acceptance checklist and the rollout communication for the FinCo app teams.

We will track the checklist in ONB-4721 (Jira) and update milestones after the dry run. If anything changes on timing, I'll update the group here.

—Monica
Sr. Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
